assertions.title: Agent Contract page loads and lists agents
steps: Opened dashboard at /dashboard, entered bearer token, and navigated to #/agent-contract.
Verified Agent selector renders a long list of configured agents.
Selected agent "default" and confirmed resolved contract content updated for selected agent (identity.agent_id=default).
Confirmed structured contract sections are present (Identity, Mission, System Prompt, Tool Policy, Delegation Policy, Memory Policy, Model Policy, Sandbox Policy, Observability Policy).
Captured browser diagnostics: console errors/logs and API resource observation entries.
observations: Agent selector contains many configured agents and supports selection changes.
Resolved contract view is organized by policy section and field/value/source columns.
No console errors were reported during this flow.

retries.details: Initial explicit wait timed out once, but URL inspection confirmed navigation had already succeeded.

frictions: agent-browser local daemon launch failed initially due missing libnspr4 dependency in default runtime.
Recovered by starting isolated Chromium with LD_LIBRARY_PATH and connecting agent-browser via CDP port 9444.
